rounds.title: Quick Quiz
rounds.intro: Answer on your phone. Faster correct answers earn a little more.

questions.q: Which scripture says “they were of one heart and one mind”?
questions.note: Moses 7:18. The people of Zion dwelt in righteousness, and there was no poor among them.

questions.q: Which scripture says Abraham's seed would “bear this ministry and Priesthood unto all nations”?
“Who shall stand in his holy place?” Which scripture answers that question?
questions.note: Psalm 24:3–4. “He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart.”

questions.q: Caleb feels invisible at school and wonders whether his life has any purpose. Which scripture helps him most?
questions.note: Moses 1:39. God's work and glory is to bring to pass our immortality and eternal life. Abraham 3:22–23 and Genesis 1:26–27 also fit.

questions.q: Ava is anxious about choosing classes and a future career. Which scripture helps her most?
questions.note: Proverbs 3:5–6. Trust in the Lord, and he shall direct thy paths.

questions.q: Which scripture teaches that a man shall cleave unto his wife and they shall be one?
When Moroni first visited Joseph Smith in 1823, he began by quoting from this prophet:
On April 3, 1836, Elijah appeared to Joseph Smith and Oliver Cowdery in this temple:
questions.note: Doctrine and Covenants 110:13–16. Elijah turned the hearts of the fathers to the children (Malachi 4:5–6).

questions.q: In 1835 the Saints in Kirtland bought four Egyptian mummies along with papyrus scrolls. Joseph Smith's translation became:
questions.note: The Book of Abraham, in the Pearl of Great Price.

questions.q: In 1828 Martin Harris showed characters from the gold plates to a scholar. This fulfilled a prophecy in:
questions.note: Isaiah 29:13–14, “a marvellous work and a wonder” (Joseph Smith—History 1:63–65).

rounds.title: Fake Out
rounds.intro: Your set writes a believable ending. Everyone else tries to find the real one. You score for every classmate you fool.

clues.prompt: “Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and ____”
clues.answer: lean not unto thine own understanding
alt: lean not to thine own understanding
house: call upon his name each morning
seek his counsel in all thy plans

clues.prompt: “This is my work and my glory, to bring to pass the ____”
clues.answer: immortality and eternal life of man
house: salvation and exaltation of all his children
joy and happiness of all mankind

clues.prompt: “Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for ____”
“Who shall stand in his holy place? He that hath ____”
clues.answer: clean hands, and a pure heart
alt: clean hands and a pure heart
house: a humble spirit and a willing mind
a righteous life and a faithful tongue

clues.prompt: “The Lord called his people Zion, because they were of ____”
house: a willing heart and a humble spirit

clues.prompt: Troy played football at BYU as ____

rounds.title: Sketch It
rounds.intro: Your set draws the same story. Everyone else guesses which story it is. Draw clearly, because you score when classmates guess right.

stories.story: Joseph fleeing and leaving his garment behind
A family choosing to serve the Lord together
God creating man in His own image
A husband and wife becoming one
A city where everyone has one heart and one mind, with no poor among them
Martin Harris showing characters from the gold plates to a scholar
Elijah appearing in the Kirtland Temple

rounds.title: Washed Clean
rounds.intro: Wager some or all of your points. Get it right to add your wager, miss it and you lose it.
rounds.q: Ethan made a serious mistake and wonders whether Jesus Christ can forgive him. “Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as ____.”
rounds.note: Isaiah 1:18. Though our sins be as scarlet, through the Savior they can be as white as snow.
